name: Humana
description: Humana is mainly a Medicare Advantage insurer: about 82.6 percent of its premiums come from Medicare plans sold to seniors, paid by the federal government (CMS) per member, with the company paying members' medical claims. It covered about 15.0 million medical members at 2025-12-31, including 5.2 million individual Medicare Advantage members. Its second segment, CenterWell, owns senior-focused primary care clinics, a mail-order and specialty pharmacy and home health, and sells mostly to Humana's own plans (about 79 percent of CenterWell revenue is intersegment). That integrated care model earns about 6 percent margin on revenue versus about 1.3 percent for the insurance segment.

gics.note: Conventional filing: Wikipedia's List of S&P 500 companies (read 2026-09-30) gives sector Health Care and sub-industry Managed Health Care; industry group and industry not listed there, left null. SEC SIC 6324.

businessLines.name: Insurance
businessLines.how: The federal government (CMS) pays Humana a fixed monthly amount per Medicare Advantage member, adjusted for health risk and quality (Star Ratings); Humana pays the members' medical claims and keeps the difference. Profit depends on claims cost trend versus CMS rates and on Star Rating bonuses.
businessLines.description: Medicare Advantage (individual and group), Medicare stand-alone Part D prescription plans, Medicare Supplement, specialty benefits, state-based Medicaid contracts and TRICARE military administrative services.

revenue.note: Premiums 122,825 (95.5% of consolidated premiums and services revenue) plus services 1,017. Premiums: Individual MA 90,403 (70.3%); Group MA 9,014 (7.0%); stand-alone PDP 6,844 (5.3%); Medicare Supplement 1,098; specialty 989; state-based contracts and other 14,477 (11.2%). Premiums +9.6% vs 112,104 in FY2024.

Premiums +9.6% vs 112,104 in FY2024.

operatingProfit.note: vs $1,289M in FY2024 (+29.1%). Margin and share are computed here from segment income over segment revenue and over consolidated income from operations $2,704M.

businessLines.name: CenterWell
businessLines.how: Primary care clinics are paid mostly through capitated, value-based contracts per Medicare Advantage patient; the pharmacy earns per prescription filled for Humana members and others; home health bills per episode of care. Most revenue is paid by Humana's own insurance segment.
businessLines.description: Senior-focused care delivery: primary care centers (Conviva and CenterWell), CenterWell Pharmacy (mail order and specialty), and CenterWell Home Health.

revenue.note: External services revenue 4,816 (+39.0%): home solutions 1,401, pharmacy solutions 1,218, primary care 2,197. Intersegment 17,657 (home 2,127; pharmacy 11,741; primary care 3,789), i.e. paid mostly by Humana's own insurance segment. Total vs 19,936 in FY2024 (+12.7%).

businessLines.revenueNote: External services revenue 4,816 (+39.0%): home solutions 1,401, pharmacy solutions 1,218, primary care 2,197. Intersegment 17,657 (home 2,127; pharmacy 11,741; primary care 3,789), i.e. paid mostly by Humana's own insurance segment. Total vs 19,936 in FY2024 (+12.7%).

operatingProfit.note: vs $1,329M in FY2024. Computed margin is over total segment revenue; share is over consolidated income from operations $2,704M (segments sum above 100% because of corporate/other items).
